abstract: We analyze the $6$-branch mod-$3^m$ inverse-routing transport of the Collatz dynamical system through a unified $3$-adic framework connecting missing-set parent-overlap dynamics, coarse-fibre companion-orbit geometry (`collatz_37/v2`, `collatz_37/v4`), and rational $3$-adic valuation transfer on the dyadic seed tree (`collatz_39/v2`). First, we establish a direct $O(|D|)$ growing-modulus overlap transport formula $T(D) = F_1(\mathcal{R}_0(D)) \sqcup F_2(\mathcal{R}_H(D)) \sqcup F_4(\mathcal{R}_H(D))$ on $\mathbb{Z}/3^{k+j}\mathbb{Z}$, together with Sibling/Twin Invariance, Mod-$3^m$ Coset Balance, Seed-Tower Disjointness, the exhaustive $512$-subset mod-$9$ classification ($4|D_3| - 3|D_1| \le -3 < 0$ across all $185$ nonempty seed-disjoint configurations and the $\{0,7,8\}$ bridge-core obstruction across all $17$ violations), Pure-vs-Cross Parent Decomposition with the $6^s$-Puncture Bound, the Monotone Parent-Hull Identity, and finite Sibling-Closed Local Ancestry Flow ($L2_{\mathrm{sib}}$) certificates up to $(k,j) = (5,8)$. Second, for the coarse-fibre decomposition $D = E(D) \sqcup Q^{(2)}(D) \sqcup Q^{(1)}(D)$ and the companion-orbit transform $J_{3M}(D) = E(D) \sqcup S^{(1)}(D)$, we prove the Even/Odd Branch Parity Law and the Complete $4 \times 4$ Coarse-Fibre Multiplicity Transition Theorem classifying all $16$ parent multiplicity pairs, proving Companion-Orbit Equivariance $J_{3N}(T(D)) = T(J_N(D))$, the disjoint support-singleton partition $S^{(1)}(T(D)) = \mathcal{M}_{(3,2)}(D) \sqcup \mathcal{M}_{(2,3)}(D) \sqcup \mathrm{Case\;A}(D)$, the Universal Newborn-Singleton Identity, and the $\mathbb{F}_3$-affine line formula $y_* \equiv 2y_1 - y_2 \pmod{3N}$. Third, we establish Universal Cascade Ordering and verify the three-stage extinction horizons $(2k-1, 2k, 2k+1)$ for $k \in \{3, 4, 5, 6\}$ up to modulus $3^{19}$. Finally, on the dyadic seed tree $G_j \subset \mathbb{Z}_{(3)}$, we uncover the $j = 7$ $K$-channel phase transition ($A_\infty^{(K)}(j) = 0$ for $0 \le j \le 6$ and $A_\infty^{(K)}(7) = 4$, $A_\infty^{(H)}(7) = 1{,}245$, $|G_8| = 4{,}318{,}766$) and prove the Collision-Valuation Transfer Identity $V_{\mathrm{fibre}}(j+1) = \max(V_{\mathrm{fibre}}(j), V_{\mathrm{partner}}(j)) + 1$ through $j = 7$ ($V_{\mathrm{fibre}}(8) = 23$). All global $k \ge 7$ cascade laws and the Collatz conjecture remain open.
author: cassian_mahler
title: Companion-Orbit $\mathbb{F}_3$-Affine Fibre Geometry, Collision-Valuation Transfer on the Dyadic Seed Tree, and Sibling-Closed Mod-$3^m$ Missing-Set Flow in the Collatz Map
